title: Sparse optimal control in the Wasserstein space
summary: We study sparse optimal control of a non-local continuity equation, where the goal is to steer a distribution via finitely many controllable agents or actuators. This model arises naturally in mean-field multi-agent systems and takes the form of a coupled PDE-ODE system where the PDE describes the evolution of the distribution and the controlled ODE captures the dynamics of the controllable agents.
